mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCtBuyerProfilePopList */ SELECT A.ORG_CODE, A.ORG_NAME, A.STATUS, A.CONTRACT_FIRST_DATE, A.CONTRACT_START_DATE, A.CONTRACT_END_DATE, A.CONTRACT_VALIDITY_DATE, A.CONTRACT_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='CTTP' AND CODE = A.CONTRACT_TYPE) AS CONTRACT_TYPE_TEXT, A.CONTRACT_NOTE, A.CONTRACT_IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(TRIM(A.CONTRACT_IMAGE_KEY), '', 0, 1) AS CONTRACT_IMAGE_KEY_IMG, A.SALES_MAP_IMAGE_DIR, A.SALES_MAP_IMAGE_NAME, A.ORG_CHART_IMAGE_DIR, A.ORG_CHART_IMAGE_NAME, A.SYS_PROCESS_IMAGE_DIR, A.SYS_PROCESS_IMAGE_NAME, A.PAR_AMOUNT, A.RE_CONTRACT_START_DATE, A.RE_CONTRACT_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ADD_DATE, A.ADD_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHANGE_DATE, A.CHANGE_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NAME, A.PROCESS_STATUS, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='PFST' AND CODE=A.PROCESS_STATUS AND FLAG='Y') AS PROCESS_STATUS_TEXT, A.CONTRACT_KIND, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='PFST' AND CODE=A.CONTRACT_KIND AND FLAG='Y') AS CONTRACT_KIND_TEXT FROM KEP_BUYER_ORG_MNG A WHERE 1=1 AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.ORG_CODE = #{org_code}

/* selectMasterMdCtBuyerProfileMappingList */ SELECT COM_CODE, COM_NAME_LOC, IRS_NO, CEO_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE 1=1 AND COM_CODE IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TEXT1 = #{st_org_code} AND TYPE = 'PFMP' AND FLAG = 'Y') ORDER BY COM_CODE

/* selectMasterMdCtBuyerProfileCardList */ SELECT BUYER ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,VISIT_DATE ,VISIT_TIME ,STATUS ,VISIT_TYPE ,SUBSTR(VISIT_NOTE ,0,50) AS VISIT_NOTE ,IMAGE_KEY ,DECODE(IMAGE_KEY, NULL, '0', '1') AS IMAGE_FLAG ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(VISIT_DATE || VISIT_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CSTMR_VISIT_DATE ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 CD WHERE CD.TYPE = 'K003' AND CD.CODE = DT.VISIT_TYPE ) AS VISIT_TYPE_NM ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 CD WHERE CD.TYPE = 'CP15' AND CD.CODE = DT.VISIT_TYPE ) AS VISIT_MDCT_NM ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_USER_DEPT ,(SELECT A.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE A.USER_ID = DT.ADD_USER_ID ) AS USER_NAME_LOC ,SUBSTR(VISIT_NOTE,0,INSTR(REPLACE(REPLACE(VISIT_NOTE,CHR(13),''), CHR(10),'PWDENTTER##!!'),'PWDENTTER##!!')) AS VISIT_NOTE_TITLE FROM KEP_VISITDT DT WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TEXT1 = #{st_org_code} AND TYPE = 'PFMP' AND FLAG = 'Y') AND STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY VISIT_DATE DESC

/* getMasterMdCtBuyerProfileOrgCode */ SELECT 'PF' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3, 2) || TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(ORG_CODE, 5, 6)+1), 1) , 'FM000000') AS ORG_CODE FROM KEP_BUYER_ORG_MNG WHERE ORG_CODE LIKE 'PF'|| SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3, 2) || '%'
mapper.update: /* insertMasterMdCtBuyerProfilePop */ INSERT INTO KEP_BUYER_ORG_MNG ( ORG_CODE, ORG_NAME, CONTRACT_FIRST_DATE, CONTRACT_START_DATE, CONTRACT_END_DATE, CONTRACT_VALIDITY_DATE, CONTRACT_TYPE, PROCESS_STATUS, CONTRACT_KIND, CONTRACT_NOTE, CONTRACT_IMAGE_KEY, SALES_MAP_IMAGE_DIR, SALES_MAP_IMAGE_NAME, ORG_CHART_IMAGE_DIR, ORG_CHART_IMAGE_NAME, SYS_PROCESS_IMAGE_DIR, SYS_PROCESS_IMAGE_NAME, ADD_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_USER_ID, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{ORG_CODE}, #{st_org_name}, #{st_contract_first_date}, #{st_contract_start_date}, #{st_contract_end_date}, #{st_contract_validity_date}, #{st_contract_type}, #{st_process_status}, #{st_contract_kind}, #{st_contract_note}, #{st_contract_image_key}, #{st_sales_map_image_dir}, #{st_sales_map_image_name}, #{st_org_chart_image_dir}, #{st_org_chart_image_name}, #{st_sys_process_image_dir}, #{st_sys_process_image_name}, SYSDATE, #{st_user_id}, SYSDATE, #{st_user_id}, 'C' )

/* saveMasterMdCtBuyerProfilePop */ UPDATE KEP_BUYER_ORG_MNG A SET A.ORG_NAME = #{st_org_name}, A.CONTRACT_FIRST_DATE = #{st_contract_first_date}, A.CONTRACT_START_DATE = #{st_contract_start_date}, A.CONTRACT_END_DATE = #{st_contract_end_date}, A.CONTRACT_VALIDITY_DATE = #{st_contract_validity_date}, A.CONTRACT_TYPE = #{st_contract_type}, A.PROCESS_STATUS = #{st_process_status}, A.CONTRACT_KIND = #{st_contract_kind}, A.CONTRACT_NOTE = #{st_contract_note}, A.CONTRACT_IMAGE_KEY = #{st_contract_image_key}, A.SALES_MAP_IMAGE_DIR = #{st_sales_map_image_dir}, A.SALES_MAP_IMAGE_NAME = #{st_sales_map_image_name}, A.ORG_CHART_IMAGE_DIR = #{st_org_chart_image_dir}, A.ORG_CHART_IMAGE_NAME = #{st_org_chart_image_name}, A.SYS_PROCESS_IMAGE_DIR = #{st_sys_process_image_dir}, A.SYS_PROCESS_IMAGE_NAME = #{st_sys_process_image_name}, A.CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE, A.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, A.STATUS = 'R' WHERE 1=1 AND A.ORG_CODE = #{st_org_code} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'

/* insertMasterMdCtBuyerProfileMapping */ INSERT INTO ICOMCOD2 ( TYPE, CODE, COMPANY_CODE, TEXT1, FLAG, ADD_DATE ) VALUES ( 'PFMP', #{COM_CODE}, 'KRKORE0001', #{ORG_CODE}, 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') )

/* updateMasterMdCtBuyerProfileReContract */ UPDATE KEP_BUYER_ORG_MNG A SET A.PAR_AMOUNT = #{st_par_amount}, A.RE_CONTRACT_START_DATE = #{st_contract_start}, A.RE_CONTRACT_END_DATE = #{st_contract_end}, A.CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE, A.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, A.STATUS = 'R' WHERE 1=1 AND A.ORG_CODE = #{st_org_code} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'

SELECT 'CT' || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3, 2) || TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(CONTRACT_NO, 5, 6)+1), 1) , 'FM000000') AS CONTRACT_NO FROM KEP_RE_CONTRACT WHERE CONTRACT_NO LIKE 'CT'|| SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 3, 2) || '%'
/* insertMasterMdCtBuyerReContract */ INSERT INTO KEP_RE_CONTRACT ( CONTRACT_NO, ORG_CODE, CONTRACT_STATUS, CONTRACT_TYPE, CONTRACT_START, CONTRACT_END, CONTRACT_USER_ID, PAR_AMOUNT, ADD_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{st_org_code}, 'A', -- ICOMCOD1.TYPE='RWST' #{st_contract_type}, #{st_contract_start}, #{st_contract_end}, #{st_user_id}, #{st_par_amount}, SYSDATE, #{st_user_id}, SYSDATE, #{st_user_id} )
